notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 8/15
notes.notes: [p]Today we're deploying an update to the PTS. You can find the patch notes below.[/p][p][/p][h1]C.A.M.P.[/h1][p][/p][p align="start"]After our PTS update on 8/13 we saw reports that some C.A.M.P.S. were still having an overbudget issue when compared to the C.A.M.P. on the live server. We made an adjustment in today’s patch so those C.A.M.P.S. should no longer have this issue.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]If you were affected by this, please login and let us know if your C.A.M.P. budget issue was fixed![/p][p][/p][h1]Workshop[/h1][list][*][p]Various bug fixes to door lock UI - it should be fully functional so let us know if something is wrong.[/p][/*][*][p]More bug fixes to Replace feature UI.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Known Issues[/h1][list][*][p]We're aware of an issue with filters with this update causing the feature to not function as expected. We're on it!.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 8/13
notes.notes: [p]Today we have deployed an update to the Public Test Server. Please read on below for the patch notes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Item Locking[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Players can now lock and unlock items in their stash when accessed via the My C.A.M.P. Device.[/p][/*][*][p]Power Armor pieces will now keep their Locked/Unlocked status when added to or removed from a Power Armor Chassis.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]V.A.T.S[/b][/h3][p align="start"]With today’s PTS update we’re making some additional changes to how V.A.T.S. calculates Hit Chance. We’re making these changes with the intention of allowing certain buffs, mods and perks to have more of an effect on improving Hit Chance.[/p][list][*][p]Perception now provides a larger benefit to hit chance.[/p][/*][*][p]Recoil and cone of fire now play a more prominent role in deciding hit chance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Items should now rotate in the same direction as they do on the live servers (sorry about that, we never meant to swap those!)[/p][/*][*][p]We've tamed the experience of using controller bumpers to scroll through categories. No longer will that scroll run free.[/p][/*][*][p]Placement error messages should now properly clear.[/p][/*][*][p]The menu now remembers which mode you were in when you re-enter it.[/p][/*][*][p]“New” category will now show one entry per new item purchased or unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Items in “New” category can now properly be placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugfixes around the Replace functionality - including instances of the cursor jumping to the top of the list.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 8/1
notes.notes: [h3][b]C.A.M.P.[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where players were unable to put items back in Aid Box after removing them.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the description for the Executioner's legendary mod.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Tenderizer Salty and Peppered mods:[/p][list][*][p]Salty now adds Armor Penetration.[/p][/*][*][p]Peppered adds Limb Damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Rad Sponge point cost was increased to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Grim Reapers Spring that caused it to not work on every kill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Kneecapper and Heavy Hitter's that caused them to not operate as they were described.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][p]Over the course of this PTS we’ve rolled out a lot of changes to help give the new Workshop UI a solid foundation for all C.A.M.P. builders in the Wasteland. Today's update includes some behind-the-scenes updates, in addition to what's below, to make sure things are solid.[/p][p]We need you to jump in, build, browse, and see what breaks! Your feedback is important. Please report any bugs, odd behavior, or suggestions through our channels in the [url="https://discord.gg/bethesdagamestudio"]Bethesda Game Studios Discord[/url].[/p][p]Thank you and happy building![/p][list][*][p]The correct number of stored items now displays properly on Workshop items.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother Navigation:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed flickering when expanding item categories.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where variant lists showed data from previously selected items.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]History subcategories now update correctly when changes occur.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed crashes in Workshop Build Mode related to item selection.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 7/31
notes.notes: [p]Hey Everyone, today the team is deploying an update to the Public Test Server. You can find today's patch notes below.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][p][b]Miscellaneous Combat Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Executioner's legendary mod now is an additive damage boost instead of multiplicative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the range and ammo capacity for the Cryolator's Crystallizing Barrel.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where players couldn't deal self-radiation damage with the Gamma Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Bomb Scientist where it would work with weapons other than thrown grenades.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapon Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed an issue where players couldn't deal self radiation damage with the Gamma Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unintended range, recoil, etc. effects from the standard barrel mod for the V63 Laser Carbine.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemy Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Revert a couple of unintended health changes for the Ultragenetic Deathclaw and Ultragenetic Mole Miner Stalker (Raids)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the health and resistances of the EN06 Guardian (Raids)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Poison damage immunity from Super Mutants and Robobrains[/p][list][*][p]Super mutants are still highly resistant to Poison damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted Super Mutant resistances.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mod Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Executioner's legendary mod now is an additive damage boost instead of multiplicative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the range and ammo capacity for the Cryolator's Crystallizing Barrel mod.[/p][/*][*][p]The Minigun Shredder mod no-longer benefits from the Radioactive Strength perk.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed an unintended damage bonus from the Laser Gun and Ultracite Laser Gun Aligned Automatic Barrel mods.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing Cryo damage on the Freezing mod for the Electro Enforcer[/p][/*][*][p]Mods which convert weapons from semi-auto to automatic:[/p][list][*][p]Shots to max recoil: +150% -> +250%[/p][/*][*][p]Removed 25% penalty to recoil recovery speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Now increases minimum cone of fire by 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Delay before cone of fire recovery: +35% -> +15%[/p][/*][*][p]Cone of fire increase per shot: -15% -> -35%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Item Locking[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The new setting to allow or block the use of locked consumables should now be working as expected.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mischief Night[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Lost have put on their Halloween costumes to join the spooky festivities.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve made changes that we believe will help the overall performance of the event. Please let us know how it goes![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Replace Mode[/b]: You can now swap out placed items without needing to scrap and rebuild. Making C.A.M.P. customization smoother and faster.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Missing Icons[/b]: Visual indicators for key camp elements have returned, helping you quickly identify “what’s what” in the subcategory variants lists.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blueprint Selection Fixes[/b]: We’ve resolved inconsistencies when selecting blueprints, so your saved layouts should behave more predictably.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Scrapping bug to disable scrapping when nothing is selected.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 7/18
notes.notes: [p]Today the team deployed an update to the Public Test Server for the next major Fallout 76 patch.[/p][p]Full patch notes for this update are below.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][p][b]Miscellaneous Combat Balance Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a few cases of thrown weapons not scaling with player level.[/p][/*][*][p]Pain Train once-again scales its damage with player level.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Hat Trick perk to deal 70% damage per bounce instead of 80%.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Concentrated Fire perk to increase VATS hit chance for non-automatic weapons by 4/8/12% per shot (automatic is still 1/2/3%).[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the V63 Laser Carbine's AP cost back to 30 instead of 40.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultracite Ammo has returned to the contextual ammo pool.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Increased the damage of the following weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p].50 Cal Machine Gun: 42 -> 52[/p][/*][*][p]Light Machine Gun: 42 -> 47[/p][/*][*][p]Minigun: 25 -> 29[/p][/*][*][p]Gatling Gun: 103 -> 112[/p][/*][*][p]Gauss Minigun: 53 -> 59[/p][/*][*][p]Flamer: 32 -> 42[/p][/*][*][p]Plasma Caster: 87 Physical, 87 Energy -> 103 Physical, 103 Energy[/p][/*][*][p]Cryolator: 47 -> 52[/p][/*][*][p]V63 Laser Carbine: 47 -> 59[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Reduced the damage of the following weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ultracite Laser Gun: 87 -> 80[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mod Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]"True" mods now primarily improve crouching and sighted aim for weapons (highest overall precision).[/p][/*][*][p]"Stabilized" mods now increase the ability to use a weapon accurately while moving but benefit less from crouching and ADS.[/p][/*][*][p]"Aligned" mods now increase V.A.T.S. hit chance and reduce AP cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some weapon mods to be more consistent in how they change weapon durability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an unintended interaction with Plasma Gun Pulse Capacitors and Flamer Barrels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some inconsistent applications of semi-auto -> auto mod damage adjustments on Plasma Flamer mods.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Brotherhood Recon Rifle to have slightly higher damage, but higher AP cost, higher recoil, higher weight, and lower durability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Crossbow Prime Frame had much longer range than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ultracite Laser Gun Sniper barrel mods would deal less damage than intended when fully charged.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect VFX on the V63 Laser Carbine when using the Explosive legendary mod[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments to Semi-Automatic -> Automatic Weapon Mods:[/b][/p][p]Note: This is in addition to the existing effects of these mods.[/p][list][*][p]Ammo Capacity: +30% -> +50%[/p][/*][*][p]Now reduces reload speed by 10%[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments to Large Magazines:[/b][/p][p]Note: This applies to most mods that increase ammo capacity without providing an additional effect such as quicker reloads or armor penetration.[/p][list][*][p]Ammo Capacity: +50% -> +100%[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Draw Time: +25% -> +35% (slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Reload Time: +20% -> +35% (slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Sighted Transition Time: +20% -> +35% (slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Weight: +35% -> +50%[/p][/*][*][p]Durability: -7.5% -> -10%[/p][/*][/list][p]Value has been decreased to +25% on the other ammo capacity mods (the Large Magazine mods listed above will remain at +40%)[/p][p][b]Adjustments to Hardened Receivers:[/b][/p][p]Note: This does not apply to Hardened receivers and similar mods on weapons which are automatic by default (.50 Cal Machine Gun Heavy Barrel, etc.)[/p][list][*][p]Bonus Damage: notes.title: Inside the Vault – C.A.M.P Building and Combat Public Test Server
notes.notes: [p][/p][h2][b]PTS Update – 7/11[/b][/h2][p]We hope you all have enjoyed the new Workshop UI, relaxed build rules, and the combat changes introduced in this Public Test Server (PTS) so far. We’ll continue to make more adjustments to the new UI and combat in future updates.[/p][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][p][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/p][list][*][p]Floater Flamer and Floater Freezer grenade explosions no-longer damage enemies through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Enclave Plasma Gun mods weren't dropping from Enclave events.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which prevented some thrown weapons from scaling with player level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which prevented non-physical damage from being added via weapon mods (including some default mods on weapons such as the Plasma Cutter).[/p][list][*][p]Note: This fix has the side-effect of significantly reducing damage dealt by Pain Train and some non-explosive thrown weapons - an additional fix will be introduced at a later date.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Adjusted the base damage for the following weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Submachine Gun: 52 -> 64[/p][/*][*][p]10mm SMG: 72 -> 59[/p][/*][*][p]Floater Gnasher Grenade (Poison DoT): 182 per second -> 140 per second[/p][/*][*][p]Floater Flamer Grenade (Fire DoT): 300 per second -> 257 per second[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjusted the rate of fire for the following weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Submachine Gun: +15%[/p][/*][*][p]10mm SMG: -10%[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjusted the base range for the following weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Light Machine Gun: 132 -> 185[/p][/*][*][p]Minigun: 130 -> 175[/p][/*][*][p].50 Cal Machine Gun: 103 -> 144[/p][/*][*][p]Submachine Gun: 109 -> 152[/p][/*][*][p]Gatling Gun: 137 -> 191[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjusted the reload animations for the following weapons:[/b][/p][p]The Assault Rifle provided the highest damage-per-shot of the rifles and had the fastest reload speed. Today’s change helps ensure other rifles can compete and fit into their roles better.[/p][list][*][p]Assault Rifle: Approx. 2.08s -> 3.02s[/p][/*][*][p]Radium Rifle: Approx. 3.57s -> 2.85s[/p][/*][*][p]Handmade: Approx. 3.03s -> 2.43s[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Rifle: Approx. 3.15s -> 2.68s[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Ultracite Ammo[/b][/h3][p]We've been listening to your feedback on Ultracite Ammo and Prime Receivers, and have taken a close look at where things stand today—and where we’d like to take them in the future.[/p][p]To start, results from the PTS have made it clear: this change isn’t quite ready for prime time (pun absolutely intended).[/p][p]While we’re still excited about the idea of Ultracite Ammo playing a more meaningful role in combat and exploration, we recognize that it needs a broader set of supporting changes to truly feel rewarding.[/p][p]That said, there’s still a core issue we want to address from the original design: [b]The flat damage increase creates a dominant choice, discouraging players from experimenting with other options.[/b][/p][p]Here's what we’re planning to do with this ammo type during the PTS:[/p][list][*][p]Restore Ultracite Ammo to being part of Contextual Ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust Prime Receiver damage to match other top-tier receivers—no longer exceed them.[/p][/*][*][p]Retain bonus damage to Scorched enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p]This brings Ultracite Ammo in line with other high-damage options without making them obsolete. While this is definitively a nerf, we feel that now, when so much of the playing field has shifted, is the right time to make this change.[/p][p]BUT! Looking ahead...We’re committed to making Ultracite Ammo feel like a powerful, rewarding player choice—something that’s earned through exploration and overcoming tough challenges. We want it to feel valuable and impactful, not just a stat boost.[/p][p]We’re open to your ideas on how to elevate this ammo type further, so tell us what would make it feel more special. Your feedback on the current experiment was extremely valuable, and we really appreciate the time that went into discussing it![/p][p][b]Note[/b]: We’re still in the process of making these changes, so they won’t be reflected in the PTS today. We will let you know when they arrive.[/p][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stored and Blueprinted categories added and now accessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Workshop: Accept button now correctly displays the “E” binding on the bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Refresh budget bars now trigger correctly when changing subcategories.[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically return to last selected Items Panel when switching from Edit mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual indicator on the item thumbnails to show they have variants available.[/p][/*][*][p]Subcategories are now displayed in the variants header.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Crash fix when placing items via Workshop handling.[/p][/*][*][p]Cannery can now be placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump functionality restored after switching back from Modify mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Mort's Edu-Tape #3 now correctly references the generator location.[/p][/*][*][p]Power requirements now display.[/p][/*][*][p]Budget Bar updates immediately after an item is placed.[/p][/*][*][p]We no longer display “Variant: None” for non-buildable objects like wallpaper and lock. Non-buildable objects display the Category name and Item Index.[/p][/*][*][p]The Minimize/Maximize Variants Panel options are properly labeled in the Options Menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Content Organization[/b][/p][p]New Additions:[/p][list][*][p]Spooky Scarecrows added to the Holiday subcategory.[/p][/*][*][p]Doors have been reorganized into condensed lists:[/p][list][*][p]Steel Doors[/p][/*][*][p]Wooden Doors[/p][/*][*][p]Steel and Wood Doors[/p][/*][*][p]Curtain Doors Stash Boxes have also been reorganized:[/p][/*][*][p]Suitcases[/p][/*][*][p]Metal Cabinets[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Future Content[/b][/h3][p]To help your C.A.M.P building endeavors with the new Workshop UI and relaxed build rules we unlocked additional workshop items for all PTS players. Unlocking these items also meant that some prototype weapons, armor, and 4-Star Legendary Mods were revealed.[/p][p]Thank you all for the feedback you’ve provided on these items so far.[/p][p]As a general reminder, if you see something in the PTS that we don't specifically call out it's safe to assume that the content is not planned for the update that we're currently testing.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Original Article[/b][/h3][p]For the dwellers who dream of a C.A.M.P. of their own. A space that allows them to unabashedly express their identity. Those who leave their resources unlocked just in case there’s a dry-mouthed wanderer who needs a sip of water. Also, for those who enjoy creating extremely extravagant mazes, museums, and bringing the arts to Appalachia. We see you and we hope that this update allows you to further scratch that creative itch in your mind.[/p][p]The C.A.M.P. building experience changes with this update. Relaxed Build Rules give you more freedom to build the way you want to build. We have also been testing out a new UI for the Workshop experience to make it easier than ever to find and keep track of the items you want.[/p][h3][b]How to Participate in the PTS[/b][/h3][p]All players who own a copy of Fallout 76 on Steam can participate in our PTS. Please note that progress from the PTS does not carry over into the live game. The Atomic Shop is also disabled during this testing period.[/p][p]To install the PTS, open your Steam library, and install “Fallout 76 Public Test Server”.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Relaxed Build Rules[/b][/h3][p]Relaxed Build Rules are activated for Adventure Mode. Unleash your creativity by letting your C.A.M.P. items float, intersect with each other, or be unsupported![/p][p]Let’s go over some of the most common scenarios you’ll experience when building a C.A.M.P. and talk about how these new build rules will affect them.[/p][p][b]Snapping Items[/b][/p][p]Items can still snap together in the way that they used to, but now items that used to require snapping are allowed to not snap.[/p][p]Over-snapping is possible. Think of having a floor tile with an item attached to it. Two floor tiles can be placed on top of each other with one tile rotating the dresser to a different spot. Walls can also be built beneath the floor, and upper floors can be attached to walls without the need for a staircase.[/p][p][b]Placement Mode Toggles[/b][/p][p]Three placement modes are available to help you place items in your C.A.M.P. Snap Mode (Normal) – Place items the way you’re used to. Collision Mode – Items will not auto-snap but will consider collisions. Free Mode – No snapping and no collisions.[/p][p][b]Placement Restrictions[/b][/p][p]While there are still some items that require ground placement (e.g. crops, extractors, items that require water to be placed), placement restrictions have been loosened for others. Allowing you to place them freely. Yes, this means in the air too.[/p][p][b]Foundations[/b][/p][p]Items that used to require a foundation to be placed no longer have that requirement.[/p][p][b]Power Cables[/b][/p][p]Can now be built even if the cable intersects with another object![/p][p][b]Blueprints[/b][/p][p]No changes here in relation to the new build rules. You can build blueprints with intersecting, floating or unsupported objects in it. We expect that laxing the rules on adventure mode servers is going to allow you to create some truly amazing C.A.M.P.s and we need your help pushing things to the limit during this PTS.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Workshop 2.0[/b][/h3][p]Coming along in this update is a complete rework of the Workshop menu! With a refreshed focus on findability and organization, this new UI should make it a lot easier for you to get to the items you need. We’ve been testing this internally and are excited for you to get your hands on it.[/p][p]To assist in your C.A.M.P. building endeavors, we’ve unlocked a lot of workshop items to give you more items to build with! These workshop items will NOT persist beyond the PTS. Please Note: The full functionality of Workshop 2.0 will not be available at the start of the PTS begins.[/p][p]Features coming later in the PTS:[/p][list][*][p]History Category[/p][list][*][p]New[/p][/*][*][p]Recent[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprinted[/p][/*][*][p]Stored[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Filter Options[/p][list][*][p]These are currently grayed out.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]New Main and Subcategories[/b][/p][p]One of the first things you’ll notice (other than the new UI), is the consolidated main categories and new subcategories which will host all your Workshop items. We believe that this new categorization will allow you to get to what you’re looking for a lot quicker than before.[/p][p]The categories are:[/p][list][*][p]Quests[/p][list][*][p]Objectives (This category only appears when a quest is active and will disappear after the quest is completed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]C.A.M.P. so you can get a look at the piece before placing it. Please let us know how you feel about the categories and their current placement once you’re able to play with this new UI yourself![/p][p][b]Modify Menu[/b][/p][p]The Modify Menu, your main tool for customizing your C.A.M.P. has also received a facelift, providing direct access to editing features.[/p][list][*][p]Edit Mode: Use this when you want to:[/p][list][*][p]Pick up and move items[/p][/*][*][p]Scrap or store things you've already built[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Wallpapers: Want to change the look of your walls? This lets you:[/p][list][*][p]Add wallpaper to give your C.A.M.P. a fresh style[/p][/*][*][p]Remove wallpaper if you want to go back to basics[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Locks: Keep your stuff safe! Use locks to protect:[/p][list][*][p]Doors[/p][/*][*][p]Generators[/p][/*][*][p]Resource collectors[/p][/*][*][p]This helps prevent other players from taking your things.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Blueprints: Love your setup? Save it! Blueprints let you:[/p][list][*][p]Save your creations[/p][/*][*][p]Place them again later, even if you move your C.A.M.P.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Workshop 2.0 Known Issues[/b][/p][p][b]Building & Placement Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Can't Place on Destroyed Objects: Players are unable to place new walls or roofs where a destroyed version of the same object still exists.[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprint Budget Bar Missing: The budget bar for blueprints is not visible, making it hard to track usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Placement Error Message Isn’t Clear: Sometimes, the red error message stays on screen even after the issue is resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Icons: Some icons are missing in the Variants Panel[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping Bug: Jumping may be temporarily disabled in Build Mode after switching from Modify Mode if your last selected item supports wire attachments (like generators or lights). Toggling modes or exiting the workshop menu will restore normal controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Cannery: The Cannery current cannot be placed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI & Menu Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minimize/Maximize Labels Reversed: The options to minimize or maximize the Variants Panel do the opposite of what they say.[/p][/*][*][p]Button Bar Doesn’t Update: After trying to place a workbench in a blocked spot, the button bar shows the wrong options. Toggling modes or exiting the workshop menu will restore normal controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Power Requirements Missing: Some powered items don’t show their power needs in the item card.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Combat Balancing Changes[/b][/h3][p]Last week we gave an early look at the balancing changes arriving in this update. There’s a lot happening in the combat/perk space, [url="https://bethesda.net/en/article/67MphFrsggUzFWcgGRKYYf/inside-the-vault-upcoming-combat-and-perk-changes"]so please take some time to read the article![/url][/p][p]For those of you who have already given it a read and shared your early thoughts, thank you! To go along with the start of the PTS, the team wanted to make further adjustment to LMGs based on the conversations we’ve seen.[/p][p]We are increasing the base damage of LMGs and introducing a way for you to craft 5.56, .308, or a .45 receiver on the weapon so you can pick the ammo the weapon uses based on your needs.[/p][list][*][p]LMG Base Damage has been changed from 37 to 42.[/p][/*][*][p]LMGs found in the world will, by default, use the new “Standard” receiver which means the weapon uses 5.56 ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting a .308 receiver on an LMG will give you more damage at the cost of slowing down the weapons rate of fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting a .45 receiver on an LMG will give you a higher rate of fire at the cost of lower damage. Prime versions of these receivers can be obtained from their standard locations. These changes will not affect your currently owned weapons. If you have a .308 receiver on your LMG it will remain .308 and won’t become a 5.56 receiver when you login.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known issue[/b]: The dynamic naming on these with the different receiver mods has not been set up yet so it will read as LMG or Prime LMG depending on the mods. This will be addressed before this update release.[/p][p]Please join our [url="https://discord.gg/BethesdaStudios"]discord.gg/BethesdaStudios[/url] to share your thoughts![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Caravans[/b][/h3][p]We're restructuring the objectives in Caravans to ensure players will get their rewards if the Brahmin is left alive, even if they are unable to complete the route. The event will now take a maximum of 7 minutes to complete.[/p][p]Caravans will now reward all players with the same number of Supplies, regardless of who started the event.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Item Locking[/b][/h3][p]You can now protect your favorite items by locking them. Lock your favorite items to protect them from accidental sale, scrap or trade! We’re excited to bring you this highly requested feature.[/p][p]Add or remove a lock anywhere you can interact with items including:[/p][list][*][p]Pip-Boy[/p][/*][*][p]Stash[/p][/*][*][p]Workbench[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo Box[/p][/*][*][p]Player to player trading[/p][/*][*][p]NPC vendors[/p][/*][*][p]Vending machines[/p][/*][*][p]Allies[/p][/*][*][p]Display cases[/p][/*][*][p]Corpses and loot bags[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Note[/b]: Locking an item will not prevent loss of junk on death.[/p]

notes.title: Fallout 76 PTS: Mutation Invasion Highlights and Update Log
notes.notes:
We’ve reopened the Public Test Server to share an early look at our upcoming Mutation Invasion Update for Fallout 76, which brings the Daily Op’s Mutations you’ve experienced to Appalachian Public Events! We hope you will join us in trying out these events and are very interested in your feedback and bug reports with us in the [url=http://discord.gg/BethesdaStudios]Bethesda Studios Discord Server.[/url]

[hr][/hr]

[h4]Introducing: Mutated Public Events[/h4]

Over the past four years, Appalachia has changed in many ways. While many of these changes are thanks to you (Project Clean Appalachia, anyone?) some of the changes are the results of daily long-lasting radiation exposure to the local inhabitants. Otherwise known as, “A Normal Day in the Wasteland.” 

Mutations you’ve grown to know and love from Daily Ops’ missions are now spilling over into Public Events! 
[list]
[*]At the top of the hour, every hour a Mutated Public Event will appear. These events are marked with a special icon to indicate they are Mutated. 
[*]Public Events for the remainder of the hour are normal events with no Mutations, which is also how this feature will function in the Live game. 
[/list]

As a reminder, mutations can be: 
[list]
[*][b]Volatile:[/b] Enemies explode upon death. 
[*][b]Active Camouflage:[/b] Enemies are clocked when not attacking. 
[*][b]Resilient:[/b] Enemies can only be slain with a melee attack. 
[*][b]Freezing Touch:[/b] Slow targets down upon attack. 
[*][b]Toxic Blood:[/b] Enemies leave behind small poisonous hazard upon death. 
[*][b]Group regeneration:[/b] Enemies heal each other when within radius.  
[*][b]Swift Footed:[/b] Increased movement speed. 
[/list]
 
[h3]New Rewards and Challenges![/h3]

Completing a Mutated Public Event will net you Legendary Items, Treasury Notes, and other rewards you see in a typical Public Event. In addition to these rewards, you’ll also earn a new crafting component called [b]Infusion Reagents. [/b]

[h2]Infusions[/h2]

Infusion Reagents can be combined at your Chemistry Workbench to create a new consumable item: Infusions! 
[list]
[*]Infusions have powerful effects that last for a short amount of time. 
[*]Each Infusion has multiple tiers that increase the magnitude and/or duration of their effects. 
[*]Unlock higher Infusion Tiers by completing new Lifetime Challenges for Mutated Public Events. The more Mutated Events you complete, the more tiers you unlock! 
[/list]

[h2]Infusion Details[/h2]

Currently, there are two infusions you can try out: 
[list]
[*][b]Steel Skin Infusion:[/b] Gain the effects of wearing Power Armor for several minutes. 
[*][b]Healing Cloud Infusion:[/b] Emit a Healing Cloud that heals you and other friendly nearby players for several minutes. 
[/list]

[h2]Additional Rewards[/h2]

[b]Mutated Package[/b]

Similar to Treasure Pails and Holiday Gifts, Mutated Packages contain a host of rewards, from contextual ammo, Infusion Reagents, and a chance for rare plans, serums and Legendary Weapons. 

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Earn more rewards with Fallout 1st![/h3]

When participating in a Mutated Public Event with Fallout 1st members present, everyone earns more rewards! Regardless of if you are subscribed or not, all event attendees will earn increased rewards. “The more the merrier” as we say, meaning if enough Fallout 1st members are present, the rewards increase.
